zara: Quick check-in: we need a very small docs PR to update the quickstart snippets for the v1->v2 rename (client.call -> client.invoke) and an embedding alias note. Can someone pick this up?
jared: I can do the quickstart snippet sweep. Will keep changes minimal: Before/After inline for each language.
priya: I'll add a 1-paragraph FAQ about the embed alias (embed-1 -> embed-lite-v2 for 30 days) and include a short Python example.
emily: I'll create 301 redirects for the old quickstart pages and schedule the banner. Post the old paths here so I can map them.
docs-bot: CI queued for branch docs/quickstart-rename. status: queued -> in_progress.
zara: thanks. small constraints: keep examples under 6 lines, show both old/new, and call out streaming framing change only in chat pages (separate PR).
jared: will open PR docs/pull/3901 and tag you all.
priya: python embed snippet: 
````
# BEFORE
emb = client.embed(model="embed-1", input="hi")
# AFTER
emb = client.embed(model="embed-lite-v2", input="hi")
````
emily: mapped paths posted in PR description. scheduling banner for 2026-04-06 09:00 PT.
zara: perfect. once PR merges, notify #support with the embed blurb.
